diagrams.notes: Rebuilt twice. The first render centered fixed-width bands on a shared axis and set each count in white inside its band; the widest band ran under its own left-hand label and the palest fills left white numerals unreadable. Recast as a left-aligned log10 bar chart: label above each bar in gray, count outside the bar end in acdark on white, bar length log10 of the value so all six orders of magnitude stay visible without a scale break. The second rebuild corrected the data rather than the drawing: bands 4-6 were re-cut on direct (non-embedded) boots after an always-on gallery iframe was found inside the human total. The chart carries no connectors; edgeRouting passes vacuously because nothing in the figure implies a direction it does not draw.
